purpose: Checks that routing evidence is evaluated only on anchor-valid WTB samples.
Checks label-support and shared-valid coverage under nearby WTB rated-wind and pitch thresholds.
Old extreme wrong-threshold sweeps are retained as sensitivity/mask perturbations, not as the main semantic falsification.
Temporal shifts, node permutation, within-time shuffle, and global shuffle should not copy actual routing semantics.
Fake boundary labels relabel shared support and must not preserve high agreement plus intervention effects.
Wrong-threshold checkpoints must not reproduce canonical routing semantics and boundary-intervention drops.
